Reasoning: The stage is an open-gripper retract. A directional_move encodes the required positive 0.10 m retract of panda_fingertip along its own tool -z axis. freeze_orientation preserves the start-of-stage world-frame orientation without adding any new axis relation. open_gripper keeps the gripper commanded open and uses gripper_opened feedback for success. manipulator_low_effort is included to reflect the required free-space/no renewed load-bearing contact feedback during retract. The exact world-frame minimum separation inequality between panda_fingertip and mug_rim_frame_0, the hooked support/contact-change condition that mug_handle_hole_frame remains supported by cup_hanger_branch_1_tip_frame, and explicit monitoring requirements cannot be directly represented with the available operators, so they are noted here but omitted as separate constraints.
